> Draw what you think causes what, then check what each method can and cannot
> tell you. This notebook is optional and was not run in the workshop. It reuses
> the instructional dataset, and you already know how its outcome was built.
>
> Pi writes the code and you decide what it means. Ask it to use `d`, `people`,
> `X_species`, `X_genes` and `y` from the setup chunk, and to put its code under
> the step you are working on.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(pROC)
library(msigdbr)

# mixOmics was added to the Codespace after the workshop. Older Codespaces
# install it here, once, which takes a few minutes.
if (!requireNamespace("mixOmics", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pak::pkg_install("bioc::mixOmics", ask = FALSE)
}
library(mixOmics)
select <- dplyr::select   # mixOmics hides these two tidyverse functions
map <- purrr::map

source(here("R/count_tables.R"))

d <- read_counts("instructional")

# One row per person: every feature averaged over the three visits. That
# avoids repeated measures, and it matches how the outcome was built.
by_person <- function(m) {
  pid <- d$metadata$participant_id[match(colnames(m), d$metadata$sample_id)]
  t(sapply(sort(unique(pid)), function(p) rowMeans(m[, pid == p, drop = FALSE])))
}

# Species: centred log-ratio, kept if present in at least 10% of samples.
sp <- d$species[rowMeans(d$species > 0) >= 0.10, ]
clr <- function(m) { l <- log(m + 0.5); t(t(l) - colMeans(l)) }
X_species <- by_person(clr(sp))

# Genes: log counts per million, the 2,000 most variable expressed genes.
cpm <- sweep(d$genes, 2, colSums(d$genes), "/") * 1e6
lcpm <- log2(cpm[rowMeans(cpm) >= 5, ] + 1)
X_genes_all <- by_person(lcpm)
X_genes <- X_genes_all[, order(-apply(X_genes_all, 2, var))[1:2000]]

# The two scores from the lecture, per person.
lacto <- grepl("^lactobacillus", rownames(d$species))
lacto_fraction <- colSums(d$species[lacto, ]) / colSums(d$species)
inflam <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") |>
  filter(gs_name %in% c("HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE", "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB")) |>
  pull(ensembl_gene) |> intersect(rownames(lcpm))
host_score <- colMeans(t(scale(t(lcpm[inflam, ]))))

people <- d$metadata |>
  mutate(anaerobe_fraction = 1 - lacto_fraction[sample_id],
         host_score = host_score[sample_id]) |>
  group_by(participant_id, outcome) |>
  summarise(micro_score = mean(anaerobe_fraction),
            host_score = mean(host_score),
            nugent = mean(nugent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(participant_id)

y <- factor(people$outcome, levels = c("term", "preterm"))
stopifnot(identical(people$participant_id, rownames(X_species)),
          identical(people$participant_id, rownames(X_genes)))
```

```{r}
dim(X_species)
dim(X_genes)
table(y)
```
